title: btrv.boxes 1.0 - per-frame bounding boxes
description: One record per source frame. Files are JSON Lines (one record per line) or a JSON array of records. The same record is the WebSocket/REST payload.

source_id.description: Identifier of the video source (file stem or user-defined id). Must match the loaded video's source id to be displayed.

frame_index.description: 0-based index of the frame in presentation order.

timestamp_s.description: Decoded presentation timestamp in seconds (pts * time_base).

producer.description: Free text identifying the software that produced the boxes.

calibration.description: Frame-level court calibration state (written by btrv; optional on import).

xyxy.description: [x1, y1, x2, y2] in source-frame pixels, origin top-left.

id.description: 0 or 1 for the two clustered teams; null when undecided.

court.description: Ground-contact point projected to court feet (sportvu_feet_v1). valid=false means the frame had no usable calibration or the point is off-court.

foot_xy.description: Optional explicit ground-contact point in source pixels (defaults to bottom-centre of the box).
